items.headline: Blinded By Workplace Horseplay, Juan Gets Lost Wages, Medical Expenses and More
items.articleBody:
Juan worked at a company that assembled tractor trailers.

Outcome: The firm settled Juan’s case, awarding wages for time missed from work, medical expenses, and compensation for the permanent blindness in his eye. justworkcomplaw

items.headline: Jane Lands Full Treatment Coverage and Lost Wages After “Workplace” Soccer Injury
items.articleBody:
Jane suffered a workplace soccer injury.

Outcome: The firm settled Jane’s case and got her the lost wages and medical treatment she deserved. justworkcomplaw
